content:
**Current members of the British Royal Family (as of 2025) and the fathers of each**

| Royal family member | Relationship / title (2025) | Father (full name & title) |
|---------------------|-----------------------------|----------------------------|
| **King Charles III** | Monarch | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (Prince Philip of Greece & Denmark) |
| **Queen Camilla** | Consort to the King | **Bruce Shand** (Lieutenant‑Colonel Sir Bruce Shand) |
| **Prince William, Prince of Wales** | Heir apparent; eldest son of the King | **King Charles III** |
| **Catherine, Princess of Wales** | Wife of the Prince of Wales | **Michael Middleton** (Michael Francis Middleton) |
| **Prince George of Wales** | Second‑in‑line to the throne | **Prince William** |
| **Princess Charlotte of Wales** | Third‑in‑line to the throne | **Prince William** |
| **Prince Louis of Wales** | Fourth‑in‑line to the throne | **Prince William** |
| **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** | Younger son of the King | **King Charles III** |
| **Meghan, Duchess of Sussex** | Wife of the Duke of Sussex | **Thomas Markle** (Thomas “Tom” Markle) |
| **Archie Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Son of the Duke & Duchess of Sussex | **Prince Harry** |
| **Lilibet “Lili” Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Daughter of the Duke & Duchess of Sussex | **Prince Harry** |
| **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** | Second son of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** |
| **Princess Beatrice, Mrs Emanuel** | Elder daughter of the Duke of York | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Princess Eugenie, Mrs Jackman** | Younger daughter of the Duke of York | **Prince Andrew** |
| **Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex** | Youngest son of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** |
| **Sophie, Countess of Wessex** | Wife of the Earl of Wessex | **Christopher Rhys‑Jones** |
| **Lady Louise Windsor** | Daughter of the Earl & Countess of Wessex | **Prince Edward** |
| **James, Viscount Severn** | Son of the Earl & Countess of Wessex | **Prince Edward** |
| **Princess Anne, The Princess Royal** | Only daughter of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** |
| **Peter Phillips** | Son of Princess Anne | **Antony Armstrong‑Jones, 1st Earl of Snowdon** |
| **Zara Tindall (née Phillips)** | Daughter of Princess Anne | **Antony Armstrong‑Jones, 1st Earl of Snowdon** |
| **Prince Michael of Kent** | First cousin once removed of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince George, Duke of Kent** |
| **Princess Alexandra, The Hon. Lady Ogilvy** | Daughter of the Duke of Kent | **Prince George, Duke of Kent** |
| **Lord Frederick Windsor** | Son of Prince Michael of Kent | **Prince Michael of Kent** |
| **Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester** | First cousin of the late Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester** |
| **Birgitte, Duchess of Gloucester** | Wife of the Duke of Gloucester | **Kai van Deurs** (her father’s full name is Kai van Deurs) |

### How the list was compiled
* The table focuses on the **senior, working members** of the Royal Family who are regularly in the public eye, plus the closest adult relatives (spouses and grandchildren) who retain royal titles or are commonly recognised as part of the family.
* “Father” refers to the biological father (or, where the father is deceased, the name of the deceased parent is still listed for clarity).
* For spouses (e.g., Camilla, Catherine, Meghan, Sophie, Birgitte), the father listed is their *non‑royal* parent.
* The line‑of‑succession order is reflected in the positioning of the children of William and Harry, but the table is **not** a formal succession chart—its purpose is simply to pair each current family member with his or her father.

### Note on scope
The British Royal Family extends to dozens of cousins, great‑cousins and their descendants (many of whom have no royal duties). Including every living descendant of King George V would make the list unwieldy. The table above captures the **core household** that appears in official engagements, media coverage, and the public’s conception of “the Royal Family” in 2025. If you need information on more distant relatives (e.g., the descendants of Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester’s siblings, or the extended Kent and York branches), just let me know and I can add those as well.
